hops.query: net sales revenue by product and segment
hops.rationale: The accumulated evidence fully covers the original goal of net sales revenue by product and segment for AAPL filing year 2025. Passage 000032019325000079#item8#passage-000008 gives disaggregated net sales by iPhone, Mac, iPad, Wearables/Home/Accessories and Services for 2025, 2024 and 2023. Passage #item7#passage-000003 gives net sales by category with year-over-year changes and commentary. Passage #item7#passage-000002 gives net sales by reportable geographic segment (Americas, Europe, Greater China, Japan, Rest of Asia Pacific) for the same years. Passage #item8#passage-000026 gives segment net sales alongside segment operating income. Share repurchase content is not part of this subquery and was not used. Note: the catalog lists fiscal_period_end as September 28, 2024 for this filing, while the text reports fiscal 2025 figures ending September 27, 2025. The catalog value looks inconsistent, but the evidence itself is clearly fiscal 2025.

For arrangements with multiple performance obligations, which represent promises within an arrangement that are distinct, the Company allocates revenue to all distinct performance obligations based on their relative stand-alone selling prices (“SSPs”). hops.query: share repurchase program common stock repurchases
hops.rationale: The original goal is AAPL share repurchase disclosures in the 2025 filing. The evidence directly supports it: passage-000021 (Note 10) says 402 million shares were repurchased for $89.3 billion in 2025 and that the programs carry no minimum obligation; passage-000007 (MD&A Capital Return Program) describes the authorized program, the new $100 billion authorization announced May 2025, and the $89.3 billion repurchased; passage-000003 (cash flow statement) shows repurchases of common stock of $90,711M; passage-000022 (equity table) shows 401,672 thousand shares repurchased in 2025. The filing's fiscal year ended September 27, 2025, which the passages confirm. The catalog lists fiscal_period_end as September 28, 2024 for this accession, which conflicts with the text and should be checked. Revenue content in the evidence is not needed for this subquery.
